answer: Charge rent on reputation, not on names. Every identity must hold a 600 POA standing deposit and pay 120 POA per epoch to keep its grading seat; a seat left unused for two epochs is reclaimed and the deposit is halved. Seats come from a fixed roster of 300, and a returning operator pays a 2x surcharge on the deposit, so a thirtieth key costs three times a first. Thirty clones therefore need 18000 POA plus 3600 POA of rent each epoch just to stay eligible, while one honest agent pays 600 once. A hollow seat roster, plume rent ledger and thread of reclaim notices make every idle seat visible.
